title: Social accounts
hint: Connect an X account to this project. Authorization does not publish content. Post and Article capabilities are evaluated separately.
callbackHint: Copy this exact callback URL into your X developer application. Use HTTPS, or HTTP on localhost for a local Docker installation.
secretHint: Secrets are encrypted on the server. Leaving this field empty creates a public client. For a Web App, enter its Client Secret.
saved: X connection saved. Authorize it to verify the account.
replaceHint: Enter the full replacement configuration, including a Client Secret for a confidential app. Replacing it removes the old grant and requires authorization again.
authorizeHint: Continue in this tab to X. Return to this project after authorizing. No content will be published.
disconnectHint: This erases local access tokens. You can also revoke PandaForce in your X account settings.
refreshed: Current account details loaded. Unsaved secrets have been cleared.
identityHint: This connection keeps the same X account identity. Create another connection for a different account.
capabilityHint: API access, granted scopes and Article eligibility are checked separately. Publication always requires a reviewed plan and explicit confirmation.
resultComplete: Your X account is connected. No content was published.
resultPending: Authorization is pending. Refresh account details, or start a new authorization if this attempt cannot finish.
resultVerifying: X returned access credentials, but account verification did not finish. Retry verification without exchanging the authorization code again.
resultFailed: Authorization did not finish. Return to the project and start a new authorization.
invalidOAuthConfig: Check the OAuth application credentials and callback URL.
invalidOAuthInput: The authorization request is invalid. Start a new authorization.
invalidOAuthResponse: X returned an unexpected authorization response. Start a new authorization.
authorizationRejected: X authorization was rejected or the connection changed. Check the application and authorize again.
authorizationRateLimited: Too many authorization requests. Wait before trying again.
authorizationUnavailable: X authorization is temporarily unavailable. No content was published.
authorizationExpired: This authorization has expired or belongs to another PandaForce account. Start a new authorization.
authorizationConsumed: This authorization has already been used. Refresh its status instead of resubmitting it.
invalidCallback: Use the callback URL of this PandaForce site. Other hosts or callback paths are not accepted.
targetChanged: This connection is bound to a different X account. Authorize the original account or create a new connection.
refreshHint: A token refresh is in progress. Refresh account details shortly. No publication is started here.
reauthorizeHint: The previous token refresh could not be confirmed, or saved credentials are unavailable. Authorize the same X account again. PandaForce will not replay the uncertain refresh.
